target: 2D total count of visible nuclei, including border nuclei.
rationale: The user identifies the image as fluorescence microscopy of Hoechst-stained U2OS nuclei and requests a 2D nucleus count. The image shows bright nucleus-like regions on a dark background, consistent with that declaration. The supplied probe reports a 696 × 520 replicated-grayscale image; grayscale and pixel statistics alone do not establish fluorescence modality.
limitations: Modality, stain, and cell-line identity rely on user-declared metadata and cannot be independently verified from appearance alone.

This operation interprets applicability only; no model-derived count evidence has been supplied.
